sections.title: SYNOPSIS
sections.text: THE PRIMARY BELT OF WESTERLIES WILL REMAIN OVER CANADA AND THE ADJACENT NORTHERN TIER OF THE CONUS TODAY...WITH A SOMEWHAT WEAKER JET STREAM ALOFT EXISTING DOWNSTREAM FROM AN EASTERN PACIFIC TROUGH TO THE GREAT BASIN/NORTHERN HIGH PLAINS. A POTENT/POSITIVE TILT SHORTWAVE TROUGH WILL DIG SOUTHEASTWARD OVER ALBERTA/SASKATCHEWAN THROUGH TONIGHT...WHILE A SURFACE LOW GRADUALLY DEEPENS IN VICINITY OF A NORTHERN HIGH PLAINS SURFACE TROUGH AND COLD FRONT MOVING INTO/ACROSS MT/ND.

sections.title: NORTHERN PLAINS
sections.text: ON THE NOSE OF A VEERING LOW LEVEL JET...EARLY DAY STORMS POTENTIALLY CAPABLE OF HAIL MAY BE ONGOING ACROSS PORTIONS OF ND/NORTHWEST MN AT THE BEGINNING OF THE PERIOD...WITH THIS ACTIVITY EXPECTED TO GRADUALLY SPREAD EASTWARD ACROSS NORTHERN MN AND WANE IN INTENSITY THROUGH THE LATE MORNING HOURS. IN THE WAKE OF THESE STORMS...SLIGHT UPPER RIDGING/WARM TEMPERATURES ACROSS THE WARM SECTOR SHOULD LARGELY CAP TSTM DEVELOPMENT FOR MUCH OF THE AFTERNOON. BY LATE AFTERNOON/NEAR-SUNSET...ISOLATED TO SCATTERED TSTMS SHOULD DEVELOP WITHIN A NORTHEAST-SOUTHWEST CORRIDOR ACROSS THE WESTERN DAKOTAS AND NORTHEAST WY/SOUTHEAST MT IN VICINITY OF A SURFACE TROUGH/TRIPLE POINT. THE STRONGEST OF THESE STORMS WILL LIKELY POSE A RISK FOR LARGE HAIL/DAMAGING WINDS...AS STEEPENING MID LEVEL LAPSE RATES/STRENGTHENING TROPOSPHERIC WINDS WILL BE CONDUCIVE FOR SOME SUPERCELLS AND MULTICELL LINE SEGMENTS. EITHER VIA THE EVENING REMNANTS OF THESE STORMS AND/OR PERHAPS MORE LIKELY...STORM CLUSTERS PROPAGATING OUT OF SOUTHERN SASKATCHEWAN/MANITOBA...IT SEEMS PROBABLE THAT STORMS MAY GROW UPSCALE TONIGHT AND SPREAD EAST-SOUTHEASTWARD INTO/ACROSS EASTERN ND/NORTHERN MN. AS SUCH...DAMAGING WINDS MAY VERY WELL BECO

sections.title: NORTHERN CA/SOUTHERN ORE/WESTERN NV
sections.text: UPPER TROUGH OFF THE WEST COAST WILL CONTINUE TO SLOWLY MIGRATE EASTWARD THROUGH THE PERIOD...WITH HEIGHT FALLS AS FAR EAST AS THE GREAT BASIN. THIS SCENARIO WILL MAINTAIN A BELT OF ENHANCED FLOW/RELATIVELY COOL TEMPERATURES ALOFT OVER THE REGION. WITH INCREASING PWAT VALUES/DAYTIME HEATING...ANOTHER ROUND OF STRONG/POTENTIALLY SEVERE AFTERNOON/EVENING STORMS ARE LIKELY TO DEVELOP OFF/NORTHEAST OF THE SIERRA CREST...WITH SUSTAINED STORMS/MULTICELLS EXPANDING ACROSS NORTHWEST NV/SOUTH ORE WITH TIME. ISOLATED SEVERE HAIL AND/OR A FEW DAMAGING WIND GUSTS WILL BE POSSIBLE.

sections.title: CAROLINAS AND SOUTHEAST/GULF COAST STATES
sections.text: AN INCREASE IN TSTM COVERAGE/VIGOR SHOULD OCCUR DURING THE AFTERNOON ESPECIALLY AMID POCKETS OF STRONGER HEATING ALONG/SOUTH OF A SLOW MOVING/ROUGHLY WEST-EAST ELONGATED FRONTAL ZONE ACROSS THE REGION. DOWNBURSTS CAPABLE OF WIND DAMAGE WILL THE PRIMARY HAZARD ON AN ISOLATED BASIS. ..GUYER/JEWELL.. 07/26/2010

sections.title: SYNOPSIS
sections.text: THE MAIN BELT OF THE JET STREAM WILL REMAIN OVER CANADA AND NEW ENGLAND THIS PERIOD...AS RIDGE PERSISTS FROM THE CNTRL RCKYS TO THE CAROLINAS...AND LOW OVER NB MOVES E TO THE MARITIMES. POTENT UPR LOW/TROUGH NOW OVER AB SHOULD CONTINUE ESE IN THE JET...REACHING ERN SK EARLY TUE. FARTHER S...A WEAKER BAND OF FLOW WILL EXIST OVER THE NRN RCKYS AND NRN HI PLNS...DOWNSTREAM FROM SLOWLY PROGRESSIVE E PACIFIC TROUGH. AT THE SFC...COLD FRONT ATTENDANT TO AB UPR SYSTEM EXPECTED TO STRENGTHEN OVER SRN AB/SK TODAY. THE FRONT SHOULD ACCELERATE SE INTO MT...ND...AND MB TONIGHT...OVERTAKING EXISTING FRONTAL ZONE AND LEE TROUGH OVER REGION.

sections.title: NRN PLNS/UPR MS VLY THROUGH EARLY TUE
sections.text: SCTD ELEVATED TSTMS NOW OVER ND MAY MOVE/DEVELOP NEWD INTO NRN MN THROUGH LATER THIS MORNING...IN RESPONSE TO CONTINUED VEERING OF ASSOCIATED MID LVL MOISTURE FEED. THE STORMS MAY YIELD A FEW SPOTS OF SVR HAIL BEFORE WEAKENING BY MIDDAY. IN THE WAKE OF THE ABOVE ACTIVITY...WEAK SHORTWAVE RIDGING/EML CAP SHOULD PROHIBIT TSTM DEVELOPMENT OVER THE REGION THROUGH MUCH OF THE AFTN. ISOLD TO WDLY SCTD STORMS MAY...HOWEVER...FORM BY LATE IN THE DAY ALONG LEE TROUGH FROM WRN ND SW INTO NW SD...SE MT...AND NE WY. A FEW STORMS ALSO MAY FORM ALONG COLD FRONT IN NE MT. THIS CONVECTION WILL BE CAPABLE OF LARGE HAIL AND DMGG WINDS...GIVEN EXPECTED MOISTURE AVAILABILITY /PW AOA 1.00 INCH IN ND/...STEEP LOW TO MID LVL LAPSE RATES...AND WIND PROFILES SUPPORTIVE OF MULTICELL LINE SEGMENTS AND PERHAPS WEAK SUPERCELLS. THE STORMS...AND/OR NEW ACTIVITY MOVING/DEVELOPING SEWD ALONG SK/MB COLD FRONT...SHOULD EVOLVE INTO AN MCS OVER CNTRL AND ERN ND TONIGHT. DEVELOPMENT WILL BE SUPPORTED BY INCREASING LLJ/ MOISTURE RETURN...AND POSSIBLY BY STRENGTHENING LARGE SCALE ASCENT PROVIDED CONTINUED EWD MOVEMENT OF SRN STREAM IMPULSE NOW APPROACHING THE NRN RCKYS. WIND PROFILES AND THERMODYNAMIC SETUP SHOULD BECOM

sections.title: NRN CA/SRN ORE/WRN NV THIS AFTN/EVE
sections.text: E PACIFIC UPR TROUGH WILL CONTINUE SLOWLY E THIS PERIOD AS ASSOCIATED SHORTWAVE IMPULSE NOW APPROACHING KVBG MOVES NNE ACROSS CNTRL/NRN CA. THIS SETUP WILL MAINTAIN A BELT OF ENHANCED SWLY FLOW AND WEAK ASCENT OVER PARTS OF CA/ORE AND NV. DAYTIME HEATING SHOULD FOSTER ANOTHER ROUND OF STRONG/POTENTIALLY SVR AFTN/EVE STORMS...ESPECIALLY FROM THE SIERRA NNE INTO THE SISKYOUS AND THE WRN GRT BASIN. SUSTAINED STORMS/MULTICELLS COULD YIELD ISOLD SVR HAIL AND/OR A FEW DMGG WIND GUSTS THROUGH EARLY TONIGHT.

sections.title: CAROLINAS TO LWR MS VLY/SRN PLNS
sections.text: ELY WAVE/INVERTED UPR TROUGH MOVING WWD ACROSS THE GULF...TX/OK UPR LOW...AND WEAKENING BACK-DOOR FRONT OVER THE TN VLY/CAROLINAS TOGETHER WILL MAKE FOR A VERY COMPLEX PATTERN OF DIURNALLY- ENHANCED STORMS OVER THE SERN STATES TODAY. WHILE ISOLD/BRIEF SVR EVENTS COULD OCCUR JUST ABOUT ANYWHERE IN THE REGION... CURRENT SATELLITE DATA AND OBJECTIVE ANALYSES SUGGEST THAT THE STEEPEST LOW LVL LAPSE RATES WILL EXIST FROM PARTS OF THE CAROLINAS WSW INTO THE TN VLY. STORMS IN THIS CORRIDOR MAY PRODUCE A FEW DOWNBURSTS WITH DMGG WIND. ..CORFIDI/STOPPKOTTE.. 07/26/2010

sections.title: SYNOPSIS
sections.text: UPPER RIDGE DOMINATES MUCH OF CONUS WITH STRONGER WESTERLIES FROM NRN ROCKIES ACROSS GREAT LAKES TO EXITING TROUGH NERN U.S. WEAK TROUGH REMAINS OFFSHORE PAC COAST WITH SOME ENERGY AND STRONGER UPR LEVEL FLOW SPREADING NEWD THRU INTERMOUNTAIN REGION ALONG WITH INCREASING AMOUNTS OF MID/UPR LEVEL MOISTURE. WEAKENING COLD FRONT EXTENDS WWD FROM NC/VA BORDER REGION TO MID MS VALLEY WHILE MOISTURE/INSTABILITY RETURN NWD THRU NRN PLAINS AHEAD OF A VIGOROUS TROUGH TRACKING ACROSS SCENTRAL CANADA.

sections.title: WRN US
sections.text: CONSIDERABLE MID/UPR LEVEL MOISTURE NOW SPREADING NEWD ACROSS NV/ID. THERE WILL BE MORE THAN SUFFICIENT HEATING ALONG WITH THE AVAILABLE MOISTURE FOR ANOTHER ROUND OF DIURNALLY DRIVEN THUNDERSTORMS DEVELOPING OFF THE HIGHER TERRAIN OF SRN ORE SWD ALONG THE SIERRA CREST. ISOLATED DAMAGING DOWNBURST WINDS AND SOME HAIL POTENTIAL WILL ACCOMPANY THESE STORMS AS MLCAPES UPWARD OF 1000 J/KG ALONG WITH LAPSE RATES IN EXCESS OF 8C/KM BY LATE AFTERNOON IN AREAS OF STRONGER HEATING. VERY STEEP LAPSE RATES NEAR 9C/KM COUPLED WITH STEADILY INCREASING MOISTURE ON THE SLY FLOW WILL LEAD TO HIGH BASED THUNDERSTORMS WRN UT INTO SERN ID BY MID AFTERNOON. WHILE DEEPER MOISTURE WILL RESIDE ACROSS NV...SUFFICIENT CAPE WILL SUPPORT A FEW STRONG STORMS WRN UT WITH LOCAL DAMAGING DOWNBURST WINDS GIVEN THE INVERTED VEE SOUNDING TYPE OF ENVIRONMENT.

sections.title: NRN PLNS/UPR MS VLY THROUGH EARLY TUE
sections.text: IN THE WAKE OF THIS MORNINGS ELEVATED CONVECTION...WEAK SHORTWAVE RIDGING/EML CAP SHOULD PROHIBIT TSTM DEVELOPMENT OVER THE REGION THROUGH MUCH OF THE AFTN. ISOLD TO WDLY SCTD STORMS MAY...HOWEVER...FORM BY LATE IN THE DAY ALONG LEE TROUGH FROM WRN ND SW INTO NW SD...SE MT...AND NE WY. A FEW STORMS ALSO MAY FORM ALONG COLD FRONT IN NE MT. THIS CONVECTION WILL BE CAPABLE OF LARGE HAIL AND DMGG WINDS...GIVEN EXPECTED MOISTURE AVAILABILITY /PW AOA 1.00 INCH IN ND/...STEEP LOW TO MID LVL LAPSE RATES...AND WIND PROFILES SUPPORTIVE OF MULTICELL LINE SEGMENTS AND PERHAPS WEAK SUPERCELLS. THE STORMS...AND/OR NEW ACTIVITY MOVING/DEVELOPING SEWD ALONG SK/MB COLD FRONT...SHOULD EVOLVE INTO AN MCS OVER CNTRL AND ERN ND TONIGHT. DEVELOPMENT WILL BE SUPPORTED BY INCREASING LLJ/MOISTURE RETURN...AND POSSIBLY BY STRENGTHENING LARGE SCALE ASCENT PROVIDED CONTINUED EWD MOVEMENT OF SRN STREAM IMPULSE NOW APPROACHING THE NRN RCKYS. WIND PROFILES AND THERMODYNAMIC SETUP SHOULD BECOME FAVORABLE FOR A QLCS STRUCTURE...WITH EMBEDDED SUPERCELLS AND FORWARD-PROPAGATING/BOWING SEGMENTS POSING A THREAT FOR HIGH WIND AND HAIL. THE SYSTEM SHOULD MOVE SE OR SSE ACROSS ERN ND AND WRN/NRN MN BY EARLY TUE.

sections.title: NRN GULF STATES/TN VALLEY EWD ACROSS CAROLINAS
sections.text: S OF WEAKENING FRONTAL ZONE AIR MASS REMAINS VERY WARM AND UNSTABLE GIVEN THE EXPECTED STRONG DAYTIME HEATING. ONLY CHANGE FROM PREVIOUS LOW PROBABILITY WIND THREAT IS TO EXPAND IT NWD THRU ERN TN AND NC. A WEAK MCV TRACKING EWD FROM MID TN WILL PROVIDE SOME UPPER SUPPORT FOR PULSE CONVECTION EWD INTO NC. SHEAR WILL REMAIN WEAK THROUGHOUT THE SERN U.S. PRECLUDING THE ADDITION OF A SLIGHT RISK. HOWEVER MLCAPES AOA 3000 J/KG CERTAINLY SUPPORT A FEW DAMAGING WIND EVENTS. ..HALES/ROBERTS.. 07/26/2010

sections.title: THERE IS A SLGT RISK OF SVR TSTMS OVER THE NRN PLAINS
sections.text: ...THERE IS A SLGT RISK OF SVR TSTMS OVER COASTAL SERN STATES... .CHANGES TO PREV OUTLOOK INCLUDE: 1/ ADD SLIGHT TO COASTAL SERN STATES AND 2/ REMOVE SEVERE PROBABILITIES FROM THE CENTRAL GREAT BASIN.

sections.title: COASTAL SERN STATES
sections.text: PULSE AND RANDOM MULTICELL STORMS HAVE DEVELOPED IN THE VICINITY OF A FRONT. BOUNDARY LAYER HAS BECOME HOT AND MERGING CELLS AND SUBSEQUENT PRECIPITATION LOADING WILL YIELD STRONG/DAMAGING DOWNDRAFTS. THIS SCENARIO WILL BE COMMONPLACE OVER A LARGE REAL ESTATE OF THE CENTRAL AND EASTERN STATES...WITH PERHAPS A HIGHER PROBABILITY OVER PARTS OF COASTAL SC WHERE SEABREEZE INTERACTION BOOSTS STORM NUMBER/MERGERS LATER THIS AFTERNOON.

sections.title: CENTRAL GREAT BASIN
sections.text: HIGHER SEVERE PROBABILITIES WILL OCCUR OVER THE SIERRA CREST ENE INTO PARTS OF SRN ORE AND WRN NV AMID STRONGER HEATING LATE AFTERNOON AND EVENING. FARTHER E...OUTFLOW FROM MORNING STORMS HAS CLEARED THE SALT LAKE VALLEY/NWRN DESERTS WITH THE BOUNDARY LAYER HAVING DRIED OVER THE NRN PARTS OF UT REDUCING BUOYANCY. MORE STORMS WILL EVOLVE OVER UT DIXIE INTO THE CNTRL MOUNTAINS THROUGH THE EVENING WHERE DEEP LAYER SHEAR WILL BE WEAKER. WHILE AN ODD DAMAGING WIND GUST MAY OCCUR...PRIMARY THREAT WILL BE HEAVY RAINFALL. REMAINDER OF THE FORECAST REMAINS UNCHANGED. /JPR ..RACY/HALES/ROGERS.. 07/26/2010 .PREV DISCUSSION... /ISSUED 1116 AM CDT MON JUL 26 2010/

sections.title: NORTHERN PLAINS
sections.text: SCATTERED SEVERE STORMS/SUPERCELLS WILL CONTINUE TO DEVELOP/SPREAD EAST-SOUTHEASTWARD THIS EVENING MAINLY ACROSS FAR EASTERN MT AND ND. ASIDE FROM A LARGE HAIL RISK WITHIN A VERY UNSTABLE/STEEP LAPSE RATE ENVIRONMENT PER 00Z BISMARCK OBSERVED RAOB/OBJECTIVE ANALYSIS...MAIN TORNADO POTENTIAL INTO LATE EVENING WILL EXIST PRIMARILY IN VICINITY OF A ROUGHLY WEST-EAST FRONTAL BOUNDARY ACROSS NORTHERN PORTIONS OF MT/ND. AIDED BY MODEST HEIGHT FALLS/STRENGTHENING FLOW ALOFT ON THE SOUTHERN PERIPHERY OF A ALBERTA/SASKATCHEWAN UPPER TROUGH...AND A NOCTURNALLY INCREASING LOW LEVEL JET...STORMS MAY EVENTUALLY MERGE/EVOLVE INTO ONE OR MORE FORWARD/SOUTHEASTWARD PROPAGATING LINEAR CLUSTERS ACROSS NORTHERN/EASTERN ND TO NORTHERN MN. AS SUCH...DAMAGING WIND POTENTIAL WILL LIKELY INCREASE LATER THIS EVENING.

sections.title: NORTHERN CA/GREAT BASIN VICINITY
sections.text: WITH SUFFICIENT BUOYANCY/FLOW ALOFT INTERPOLATED BETWEEN 00Z OBSERVED RAOBS FROM RENO/MEDFORD...POTENTIAL FOR ISOLATED SEVERE STORMS CAPABLE OF HAIL/WIND GUSTS WILL CONTINUE MAINLY THROUGH THE EARLY EVENING HOURS WITHIN A CORRIDOR FROM FAR NORTHERN CA AND SOUTHERN ORE TO CENTRAL NV.

sections.title: CAROLINAS/TN VALLEY/MID-SOUTH TO LOWER MO VALLEY/TX
sections.text: NUMEROUS MESO/STORM-SCALE DRIVEN TSTMS WILL CONTINUE ACROSS A BROAD EXPANSE INTO MID/LATE EVENING. A FEW ISOLATED DOWNBURSTS WILL REMAIN POSSIBLE THROUGH 02Z OR 03Z...BUT LOSS OF DAYTIME HEATING WILL LEAD TO DIMINISHING TSTM COVERAGE/SEVERE LIKELIHOOD. ..GUYER.. 07/27/2010
